articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu warns Donald Trump against sale of F-35s to Turkey
articles.summary: Netanyahu warned during a Fox News interview that providing F-35 fighter jets to Turkey would upset the regional balance of power and threaten Israeli air superiority, citing concerns about Turkish leadership and support for Hamas.

articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu aiming to prevent strengthening of US-Turkey ties, F-35 deal
articles.summary: Analysis of Netanyahu's two consecutive Fox News appearances as a diplomatic strategy to pressure the Trump administration to block F-35 sales to Turkey ahead of Trump's NATO summit meeting with Turkish President Erdogan.

articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu: 'My relationship with President Donald Trump is excellent'
articles.summary: Netanyahu told Fox News that US-Israel relations are strong and that he has an excellent relationship with Trump, with both countries aligned on Iran policy and recent peace agreements including the Abraham Accords and Israel-Lebanon deal.

articles.title: Netanyahu's unity government pivot could reshape Israeli politics, end boycott
articles.summary: Netanyahu's emerging campaign strategy aims to end the political boycott against him and build a broader coalition government as elections approach, framing consensus-based governance as necessary given Israel's external threats and internal divisions.

articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu and Donald Trump spoke, agreed to meet in the US 'soon'
articles.summary: Netanyahu and Trump spoke on July 4th, with Netanyahu congratulating the US president on the nation's 250th independence anniversary; the two leaders agreed to meet soon in the United States.
